scientific_question: Can a multiplicatively gated pair of independent full-input-rank procedural maps represent the dense terminal c_fc function and analytic input tangent, or is task-aligned normal information still missing even when the effective normal field is state-dependent and full rank?

theory.binding_observation: The sealed decomposition shows that projected gates with dense c_fc normals recover 0.966993/0.967048 causal JVP, while teacher gates with rank-480 normals recover only 0.237788/0.233795. Normal-direction error explains about 97.1% of exact tangent-error energy; GELU boundary motion explains about 4.0%.
theory.manifold_correction: Low-dimensional parameter evolution does not imply rank(c_fc)<768. A valid compact latent map must be allowed to materialize a full-column-rank 1536x768 feature matrix.
theory.closed_additive_families: Independent procedural atom sums, complete-function mixtures, signed coefficients, residual-coordinate modulation, one-sweep and state-conditioned butterflies, vectorized full-rank KFAC charts, and implicit coordinate decoders are already rejected. Their common limitation is an additive or single-orbit pseudo-random normal image.
theory.new_mechanism: Use two independently seeded full-column-rank procedural maps A and B. The candidate hidden function is h(x)=exp(s) * GELU(p(x)) elementwise (1+q(x)), where p(x)=scale*A*x elementwise (1+g_A)+b and q(x)=scale*B*x elementwise (1+g_B). Its exact input tangent contains diag(1+q)diag(GELU'(p))A and diag(GELU(p))B. Thus the normal field changes with x through a multiplicative cross term and spans both full-rank maps; it is not a low-rank atlas, a sum of independent atoms, or another orthogonal-frame sweep.
theory.same_run_control: The equal-coordinate additive control is h_control(x)=exp(s) * (GELU(p(x))+q(x)). It sees the same A, B, gains, bias, scale coordinate, data, optimizer, and dense c_proj, but has no multiplicative cross term. Candidate-minus-control recovery isolates bilinear gating rather than extra random features or coordinates.
theory.literature_anchor: GLU variants explicitly replace a pointwise FFN activation by an elementwise product of two linear projections. This audit uses the same algebraic mechanism only as a causal full-rank normal-field discriminator; it does not claim that generic SwiGLU quality gains imply Mapping-Network closure.
theory.paper_reconciliation: The Mapping Networks theorem is existential and local; it does not require the materialized matrix to be low rank. The paper's fixed projection, activation, modulation, stability, smoothness, and alignment ideas permit a smooth nonlinear latent map. Here the fixed procedural projections remain untrained, per-channel modulation is counted, the analytic JVP is the local smoothness/alignment target, and no dense learned basis or dense target state is retained in the candidate.
theory.oracle_scope: Dense teacher c_proj is retained only to isolate c_fc. Passing does not solve the paired full MLP; it authorizes composition theory with the separately sealed write-side evidence. Failure closes this exact bilinear full-rank feature family before any paired implementation or LM training.

candidate.name: two_map_fullrank_multiplicative_normal_field
candidate.procedural_maps: A and B are independent normalized sign-FHT maps from padded 2048 coordinates, cropped to hidden width 1536, with distinct deterministic signs for every layer/expert/map.

control.name: two_map_fullrank_additive_normal_field
control.purpose: Measure whether multiplicative gating, rather than merely exposing two full-rank random maps, supplies the missing state-dependent normal directions.

data_protocol.anti_leakage: Fit discovery A and B independently. Heldout tokens and JVP probes never affect coordinates, stopping, initialization, thresholds, or candidate selection.

fit_protocol.optimizer: AdamW on counted gate gain, value gain, gate bias, and log scale only
fit_protocol.objective: Equal-layer/equal-expert normalized dense-cproj residual-output MSE plus 1.0 times normalized exact analytic input-JVP MSE.
fit_protocol.precision: float32 fitting and scoring with float64 scalar accumulation
fit_protocol.selection: Use the final registered step. No heldout selection or gate/additive scale, seed, activation, LR, step, optimizer, loss-weight, rank, width, or threshold sweep.

decision_rule.pass: Only a two-bank all-gate pass authorizes preregistration of a paired composition oracle with the sealed write-side structure plus an initialization/Mapping-Loss shadow. It does not directly authorize LM training, MFU qualification, a larger rung, or attention work.
decision_rule.candidate_absolute_pass_control_gain_fai: If the candidate passes absolute output/JVP gates but not the frozen gain over the additive control, the causal mechanism is two-map capacity rather than multiplication; authorize only the simpler additive family for paired-theory reconciliation.
decision_rule.fail: Close this exact two-map multiplicative/additive full-rank feature family. Do not sweep activation, product offset, map count, seeds, FHT layers, scales, gains, bias, LR, optimizer, steps, JVP weight, or thresholds. Return to full-rank normal-field theory before another candidate.

systems.performance_gate: Run committed-source unit tests and an exact two-step candidate/control GPU preflight. Foreground-poll only if the full frozen audit projects to no more than five minutes; otherwise launch one verified terminal/error-only @Codex watcher immediately.
systems.callback_policy: For an expected one-to-two-hour run, terminal success and actionable failure only. Add one resettable 90-minute heartbeat only if observed runtime exceeds two hours.
